titleEn: Angle Between Hands of a Clock
title: 时钟指针的夹角
summary: 给定整点小时与分钟，返回时针和分针之间较小的夹角。
insight: 分针每分钟转六度；时针每小时三十度且每分钟继续转半度。两角绝对差若超过一百八十，取三百六十减它。
pitfalls: 时针会随分钟连续移动
十二点按零小时角度处理

solutions.title: 连续指针角度
solutions.idea: 直接计算两指针相对十二点角度。

code.java: class Solution { public double angleClock(int hour,int minutes){double minuteAngle=minutes*6.0,hourAngle=(hour%12)*30.0+minutes*0.5,difference=Math.abs(hourAngle-minuteAngle);return Math.min(difference,360.0-difference);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun angleClock(hour:Int,minutes:Int):Double{val minuteAngle=minutes*6.0;val hourAngle=(hour%12)*30.0+minutes*0.5;val difference=kotlin.math.abs(hourAngle-minuteAngle);return minOf(difference,360.0-difference)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: double angleClock(int hour,int minutes){double minuteAngle=minutes*6.0,hourAngle=hour%12*30.0+minutes*0.5,difference=abs(hourAngle-minuteAngle);return min(difference,360.0-difference);} };
